title: land works in a landing worktree of its own, so the orchestrator's checkout may hold its own changes while a landing runs
goal: backlog.py land fetches, rebases, runs done, the checks and the push in a landing worktree of its own under the clone's worktree_dir, never switching the invoking checkout's branch or reading its working tree, so an untracked or modified file there no longer stops it at the clean tree step; landings of one clone run one at a time under a landing lock that names the item being landed; the release of the worker's worktree, the intake drafts' move and the fast-forward of a clean invoking checkout after the push stay as they are

import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True)
sh('git', 'init', '-q', '.'); sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', 'commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh('python3', R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Land me', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
sh('git', 'add', '-A'); sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'item')
open(T + '/scratch-note.txt', 'w').write('an unrelated untracked file in the orchestrator checkout')
r = bl('land', iid)
out = r.stdout + r.stderr
step = re.search(r'land stopped at step ([\w -]+?)(?::|$)', out, re.M)
print('land exit', r.returncode, 'step', step.group(1) if step else None)

import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, time, json
HOLD = 0

G = ["git", "-c", "user.email=a@b", "-c", "user.name=n"]

def bl(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + "/_tools/backlog.py", "--root", T, *a], cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True)
sh(*G, "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", B, cwd=D)
os.makedirs(T + "/kb/_self/backlog"); sh("git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main", ".")
cfg = json.load(open(R + "/backlog.json", encoding="utf-8")); cfg.update(land_push=["git", "push", "origin", "HEAD:main"], land_eval=[], land_lint=[], land_stale=[])
json.dump(cfg, open(T + "/backlog.json", "w", encoding="utf-8"))
sp = re.search(r"SP-\w+", bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "S", "--goal", "g").stdout).group(0)
ids = []
for n in "ab":
    ids.append(re.search(r"ST-\w+", bl("new", "story", "--title", "Land " + n, "--goal", "g", "--touch", "kb/public/work-*.txt",
                                      "--check", "python3 -c 'import os, sys, time\nif \"" + n + "\" == \"a\" and " + str(HOLD) + ":\n    open(\"" + D + "/held\", \"w\").close(); time.sleep(" + str(HOLD) + ")\nsys.exit(0 if os.path.exists(\"kb/public/work-" + n + ".txt\") else 1)'",
                                      "--sprint", sp).stdout).group(0))
bl("answer", sp, "start", "--answer", "approve", "--by", "operator"); bl("start", sp)
open(T + "/.gitignore", "w").write(".claude/worktrees/\n_cache/\n")
sh("git", "add", "-A"); sh(*G, "commit", "-q", "-m", "items"); sh("git", "remote", "add", "origin", B)
for i in ids:
    bl("claim", i, "--by", "tester", "--commit")
sh("git", "push", "-q", "-u", "origin", "main")
for n, i in zip("ab", ids):
    sh("git", "switch", "-q", "-c", "work/" + i); os.makedirs(T + "/kb/public", exist_ok=True); open(T + "/kb/public/work-" + n + ".txt", "w").write(i); sh("git", "add", "-A")
    sh(*G, "commit", "-q", "-m", "work " + i + "\n\nKB-Work: " + i); sh("git", "switch", "-q", "main")
open(T + "/next.txt", "w").write("n"); sh("git", "add", "-A"); sh(*G, "commit", "-q", "-m", "main moves"); sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "main"); sh("git", "reset", "-q", "--hard", "HEAD~1")
def hook():
    p = T + "/.git/hooks/pre-rebase"
    open(p, "w").write("#!/bin/sh\npwd >> " + D + "/rebase-cwd.txt\nexit 0\n")
    os.chmod(p, 0o755)
def step_of(r):
    m = re.search(r"land stopped at step ([\w -]+?)(?::|$)", r.stdout + r.stderr, re.M)
    return m.group(1).strip() if m else None
hook()
open(T + "/scratch-note.txt", "w").write("x")
open(T + "/backlog.json", "a").write("\n")
before = (sh("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout, sh("git", "status", "--porcelain").stdout)
r = bl("land", ids[0]); out = r.stdout + r.stderr
after = (sh("git", "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout, sh("git", "status", "--porcelain").stdout)
head = sh("git", "symbolic-ref", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
cwds = [os.path.realpath(x) for x in open(D + "/rebase-cwd.txt").read().split()] if os.path.exists(D + "/rebase-cwd.txt") else []
under = bool(cwds) and all(c.startswith(T + "/.claude/worktrees/") for c in cwds)
done = "\"status\": \"done\"" in sh("git", "show", "main:kb/_self/backlog/" + ids[0] + ".json", cwd=B).stdout
print("land exit", r.returncode, "step", step_of(r), "| branch", head, "| checkout untouched", before == after, "| rebased under worktrees", under, cwds[:1], "| done on main", done)
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and "landed" in out and head == "refs/heads/main" and before == after and under and done else 1)

notes: Premise: in a planted clone whose item is committed, one untracked unrelated file makes land stop at step clean tree (the check prints 'land exit 1 step clean tree'). land rebases in the invoking checkout and switches its branch (_tools/bl_land.py:1835-1883), holding the host main lock only for the fetch and rebase, so a claim, a gate answer, a new item file or a stage-back made in that checkout during a landing collides with it: the 2026-10-23 sprints idled the checkout for every landing, and BG-3brdh3kd's land ran beside its stage-back and was refused at done (SP-c7oav2vn close). Planned 2026-10-24 (SP-47w4ngr6): premise reproduces on base (check 0 prints 'land exit 1 step clean tree'). Checks 1 to 3 run a whole landing in a planted clone with a local bare remote (land_push is git push origin HEAD:main there; the pre-rebase hook records where the rebase runs): 1 lands with an untracked and a modified tracked file in the invoking checkout (landed, branch and files untouched, the rebase ran under .claude/worktrees); 2 starts a second landing while the first is held inside its own done check and requires the second to name the first item and not begin its fetch meanwhile (or be refused naming it), both ending; 3 keeps the worker worktree release, the intake draft move and the fast-forward of a clean checkout, with the landing worktree still required (so it fails on base for clause 1 only). The landing worktree must not take a worker worktree's name (<item id> or agent-*), or land would release it. The fixtures live in the check commands; the host main lock is not held by them. Docs: bl_land.py and bl_close.py map to backlog.md, tools.md, code.md and git.md; skills/sprint/SKILL.md maps to AGENTS.md and maintaining.md (held by the other session's ST-2d26ca6z for now): the skill text change waits for it to land or is made without touching the held docs. Planned in SP-47w4ngr6 on 2026-10-24.
